content.title: Why Ultragenyx Stock Dropped 42% and What Comes Next
content.summary: Ultragenyx  Pharmaceutical stock has plummeted this week, after its experimental treatment for an uncommon genetic bone disease failed in late-stage trials.  Ultragenyx shares fell 42% on Monday, after the company reported results from two Phase 3 trials of its drug setrusumab, an experimental treatment for brittle-bone disease, or osteoenesis imperfecta.  Mereo BioPharma Group  Ultragenyx’s smaller, London-based partner, fell 88% on Monday and was down 1.9% on Tuesday.
